subject: science
domain: Waves and Their Applications in Technologies for Information Transfer

items.prompt:
Higher-frequency electromagnetic radiation carries ____ energy per photon.
A) more
B) less
C) no
D) negative

Which is a high-frequency, higher-energy radiation?
A) Ultraviolet or X-rays
B) Radio waves
C) Sound waves
D) Water waves

Radio waves are generally
A) not harmful
B) very harmful
C) the most harmful
D) solid

steps: Radio waves are low-energy and generally safe.

items.prompt:
Too much UV radiation can harm skin because it
A) carries high energy that damages skin cells
B) is low energy
C) cannot reach skin
D) is a sound wave
items.answer: A) carries high energy that damages skin cells

items.prompt:
X-rays are used carefully because their high energy can
A) damage living cells
B) cool the body
C) make sound
D) do nothing

How electromagnetic radiation affects matter depends on its
A) frequency and energy
B) color only
C) price
D) name

steps: Frequency and energy determine the effect.

items.prompt:
Evaluate: 'All electromagnetic radiation is equally harmful.' This is
A) wrong, because harm depends on frequency and energy
B) completely true
C) proof radio is most harmful
D) about sound only
items.answer: A) wrong, because harm depends on frequency and energy

steps: Harm varies with frequency and energy.

items.prompt:
Compared with radio waves, X-rays carry
A) much more energy and can be harmful
B) much less energy
C) the same energy
D) no energy
items.answer: A) much more energy and can be harmful
